legacy_root.title: Extract the Aider repo-map mechanism and its measured token/accuracy tradeoff
legacy_root.question: How exactly does Aider build its repo map (graph ranking over symbol references, token budget), and what evidence exists that it improves edit accuracy versus simply sending more files?
legacy_root.schema_note: Declared schema file is absent on this worktree (RES-0001 did not ship). This record still carries the Phase-2 field set named by RES-0001: claim id, canonical mechanism, source lineage, evidence tier E1-E4, confidence band, named settling probe, contradiction/support edges, freshness stamp, snapshot sha256.

ranking_algorithm.name: personalized PageRank over a directed file graph of symbol references

legacy_root.canonical_mechanism: Parse each source file with tree-sitter tag queries into defs and refs; build a directed NetworkX graph whose nodes are files and whose weighted edges run referencer-file -> definer-file; call nx.pagerank at aider/repomap.py:525 with chat-file / mentioned-ident personalization; distribute each file's PageRank mass across its outgoing symbol edges; then binary-search the ranked tag prefix at aider/repomap.py:677 until the rendered tree is within 15% of the token budget (default map_tokens=1024 at aider/repomap.py:49; 8x multiplier when the chat has no files at aider/repomap.py:56).

claims.statement: Aider's repo map ranks files by networkx.pagerank on a symbol-reference graph and trims the ranked tags to a token budget. Ranking implementation: aider/repomap.py:525.
claims.promotion_block: No paper DOI/arXiv. Mechanism existence is sourced from the implementation, which is an extract, not E1.
claims.strongest_caveat: Line numbers are pinned to commit 94bd7abd17cd; a later refactor of get_ranked_tags would move the citation. Tag quality follows tree-sitter query coverage, with a pygments Token.Name fallback for refs.

claims.statement: After ranking, get_ranked_tags_map_uncached binary-searches the ranked tag prefix (aider/repomap.py:677) until the rendered outline is within 15% of max_map_tokens.
claims.strongest_caveat: The 15% slack and the map_mul_no_files=8 expansion mean --map-tokens is not a hard cap; Aider-AI/aider#752 records this.

claims.statement: Aider's first-party docs claim the token-budgeted map is a better use of context than adding many extra files, but they do not report an isolated accuracy delta versus a more-files baseline.
claims.promotion_block: Catalog evidence rule: a headline number without its baseline is E3 and cannot promote a mechanism; a blog-reported improvement without a stated baseline is E3 and cannot promote to Tier 1. The 2023-10-22 tree-sitter post and docs/repomap.html describe the graph ranker and a 1k default budget; neither states an accuracy effect size nor a more-files control. SWE-bench Lite full-stack scores are not an ablation of the map.

source_lineage.locator: Building a better repository map with tree sitter (no numeric ablation)

independent_reproduction.control: Searched first-party writeups and public secondary analyses for an isolated repo-map vs more-files accuracy measurement. None reported a baseline plus effect size from a party independent of Aider.

claims.strongest_caveat: Qualitative FAQ advice that extra files distract the model is not a measured tradeoff. Full-stack SWE-bench numbers cannot be attributed to the map.

rails.note: Prose names a graph ranking algorithm and 1k token default; it does not name PageRank.
